name: Sesame Tuna Rice Bowl with Lettuce, Cucumber, Radish & Avocado

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place half in a large bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Drain tuna, add to the bowl with the green onion, and flake with a fork. Add mayo, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce; stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water
¾ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place additional mayo, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and garlic powder in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place on a platter.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the platter with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the platter.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Divide rice, tuna, and veggies between bowls; top with reserved green onions and sesame seeds. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!
